_readme: Approved assumption sets. The NPV engine runs in production mode only on an assumption file whose SHA-256 (canonical JSON of the assumption set plus the governed configuration files, see 03b_assumption_governance.py --hash) appears here for the same model version. Each entry records who approved what, when, and for which use. In production approval sits with the appointed / responsible actuary after the assumption committee reviews output/assumptions/assumption_indications.csv; entries are added through a reviewed change (pull request), never edited in place. The entry below is a labelled example for the synthetic practice book. Every REVIEW item raised by the indications must have an entry in review_dispositions (key = LOB.assumption); otherwise the set is treated as not approved.

approvals.scope: Synthetic practice book: model validation and demonstration only. Not for pricing or reporting.
approvals.notes: Illustrative assumptions for the synthetic book. Indications reviewed: 2 REVIEW items, both claim trend. Med Supp: normalized fit 6.82% vs 6.0% assumed; D&V: fit 2.58% vs 3.5% assumed. Disposition: keep the assumed trends, because four years of experience pin trend only to about +/-2 points (backtest Test B: using the Med Supp fit would cut NPV by about 70%), and the assumed values are the benchmark-based judgment. Anti-selection, dynamic-lapse slope, risk-adjustment capture and Monte Carlo correlations are judgment values with no experience basis on this book.

review_dispositions.MEDSUPP.claim_trend: Keep 6.0%. Normalized fit 6.82%; four years pin trend only to about +/-2 points and the fit would cut NPV by about 70% (backtest Test B). 6.0% is the benchmark-based judgment.
review_dispositions.DENTAL_VISION.claim_trend: Keep 3.5%. Fit 2.58% from four noisy years; 3.5% is the benchmark-based judgment.

approvals.scope: Synthetic practice book: model validation and demonstration only. Not for pricing or reporting.
approvals.notes: v4 assumption set. Changes from AS-SYN-2026-001: (1) claim trend set to the v4 credibility-weighted indications - Med Supp 6.75% (normalized fit 6.82%, bootstrap SE 0.41 pt, Z = 0.86 vs a 6.5% placeholder benchmark) and D&V 3.65% (fit on the new pent-up/product-normalized series 4.35%, SE 1.02 pt, Z = 0.49 vs a 3.0% placeholder benchmark). The v3 disposition (keep 6.0% / 3.5% because four years pin trend only to +/-2 pts) is withdrawn: the v4 seed study measured the sampling SD of the normalized fits at about 0.6 pt (Med Supp) and 1.2 pt (D&V), and the 6.0% / 3.5% values coincided with the synthetic generator's true trends, which no production benchmark can do. On this synthetic book the adopted Med Supp trend is above the true 6.0% (the shipped data is a +1.4 SD draw); backtest Test B reports the resulting NPV error. (2) New v4 blocks: Med Supp model points (mix from 2024-25 issues, Plan F excluded), D&V benefit categories (experience shares, neutral otherwise), Medicaid contract terms (neutral: the synthetic contract has none), Monte Carlo process risk and rate-filing response (judgment), trend / Med Supp rate-shortfall correlation set to 0 (replaced by the explicit response). Benchmarks in config/trend_benchmarks.json are placeholders: Humana's pricing trends replace them before any production use. The hash covers the assumption set AND the governed configuration files (config/claim_cost_curves.json, config/trend_benchmarks.json, config/forecast_config.json; assumption_control.GOVERNED_CONFIGS), so editing any of them needs a new approval.

approvals.scope: Synthetic practice book: model validation and demonstration only. Not for pricing or reporting.
approvals.notes: v4.1 public-source assumption basis. Every assumption is documented in config/assumption_basis.json (docs/ASSUMPTION_BASIS.md) as public source, statute, derived, judgment (with sensitivity range) or model setting. Policy: the synthetic practice book is not relevant experience for a Humana block (ASOP 25 §3.3), so no shipped value relies on it; its indications are shown and dispositioned. Changes from AS-SYN-2026-002: trend to public benchmarks (Med Supp 6.5% Trustees 2026, D&V 3.5%, Medicaid 4.5%); Med Supp rate increase 7.5% (consistency), commission 20/10 (200% rule), mortality SSA x 75%, premium tax 2.25%; D&V maintenance $50; Medicaid rate update = trend 4.5% (ASOP 49), cost ratio 88%, admin $40, tax 2.3%, capital 15%; hurdle 8.5%, earned rate 4.0%. The hash covers the governed configuration files.

review_dispositions.MEDSUPP.claim_trend: Keep 6.5% (2026 Trustees Part B per-enrollee pure trend). The 6.80% indication blends the synthetic book's 6.82% fit, which is not relevant experience for a Humana block (ASOP 25 §3.3); credibility 0 is given to it. Re-blend when Humana experience is loaded.
review_dispositions.DENTAL_VISION.claim_trend: Keep 3.5% (ADA HPI / Segal benchmark). The 3.90% indication blends the synthetic book's fit, which is not relevant experience (ASOP 25 §3.3).
